presets.title: GitHub
presets.description: GitHub's own hosted MCP server (repositories, issues, pull requests). It needs a personal access token.
presets.name: github

fields.label: GitHub personal access token
fields.help: Create one at github.com/settings/tokens and give it only the access you need. It is stored write-only and never shown again.

presets.title: Google Colab
presets.description: Google's Colab MCP server, run by mcpgate itself (it needs uv; colab-mcp is downloaded and cached the first time it is used). Works even when your browser is on a different computer: the connect tool gives Claude a link and the one SSH command you need.
presets.name: colab
